label: Whatever is IN_ACT_4 in INFINITE_3 is maximal in being
paraphrase: Open analyst bridge, not attributed and not a definitional equality: whatever is in act, formally or eminently (IN_ACT_4), in the perfection of infinite substance (INFINITE_3) is maximal in being (MAXIME_ENS_1): it has being and nothing is more a being than it (MORE_1). The infinite and being are unrelated respects of the frame, so this passage is a premise. It does not give uniqueness or greatest degree. The stronger reading 'infinite in every perfection' (in act and unsurpassed in every respect) would entail it by instantiation and is not registered.
